content.short: LayerZero is the leading omnichain interoperability protocol enabling secure cross-chain messaging and asset transfers between any blockchains.
content.description: LayerZero is a foundational blockchain interoperability protocol providing low-level cross-chain messaging primitives for sending arbitrary data between any two supported blockchains, using a decentralized verifier network (DVN) and executor model for reliable delivery. LayerZero powers many of DeFi's most used cross-chain applications including Stargate, and has processed hundreds of millions of cross-chain messages since its 2022 launch. The protocol is deployed on Mantle as a core communication infrastructure layer.
content.meta: LayerZero is an omnichain interoperability protocol for secure cross-chain communication on Mantle. Discover LayerZero on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
